prompt: Create an original 60 second instrumental funk instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: clavinet, slap bass, tight drums, rhythm guitar. Style: sixteenth-note syncopation with short call-and-response riffs. Tempo approximately 126 BPM; C major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An energetic and driving instrumental rock track featuring prominent electric guitars, a solid bassline, and dynamic drumming. The piece has a lively and upbeat feel, suitable for action or background music.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和动感的器乐摇滚乐曲，以突出的电吉他、坚实的贝斯线和富有活力的鼓点为特色。这首曲子给人一种活泼欢快的感觉，适合作为动作场景或背景音乐。
